name: Flexi Menu – Create Floating, Sticky, Dropdown, Context, Inline & Icon Menus
author: Wow-Company

sections.description:
Flexi Menu is a powerful and intuitive WordPress plugin designed to enhance your website’s navigation with floating, fixed, sticky, dropdown, context, inline, static, and icon menus. Quickly create professional, attractive menus without needing any coding skills.

Whether you’re building a simple floating menu, advanced dropdowns, fixed or sticky navigation bars, context-sensitive menus, or sleek inline icon menus, Flexi Menu provides a highly customizable solution to match your website’s design and improve user experience.

Our intuitive live menu builder allows you to design and preview menus instantly. Flexi Menu is fully responsive, ensuring excellent performance across all devices—from desktops to smartphones. Integrated FontAwesome support helps you add stylish icons easily.

Improve your SEO and user engagement by implementing accessible, responsive, and attractive menus today!

Key Features

  • Multiple Menu Types: Floating menu, Sticky menu, Dropdown menu, Fixed menu, Context menu, Inline menu, Icon menu, Static menu.
  • Easy-to-use Interface: Create and customize menus quickly without coding.
  • Live Menu Builder: Real-time preview and customization.
  • Responsive & Mobile-Friendly: Menus automatically adapt to any screen size.
  • Icon Integration: FontAwesome icons support for stylish visual navigation.
  • Test Mode: Preview menus exclusively for admins before going live.
  • Comprehensive Item Support: Add links, login, logout, password reset, registration, email, and phone actions.
  • Advanced Styling: Extensive customization options for menu appearance.
  • Universal Compatibility: Works smoothly with all WordPress themes.
  • Optimized Performance: Lightweight to ensure your site remains fast.

Support

Have questions or need help? Visit our support center.
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Flexi Menu” and install the plugin.
  3. Alternatively, download the ZIP file, upload via dashboard, or FTP upload the extracted folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins page.
  5. Go to Flexi Menu in your dashboard and click Add new.
  6. Create, customize, and save your menu.
sections.faq:
How to use Flexi Menu on multisite installations?

Do not network activate. Activate individually per site for multisite setups.

Is Flexi Menu compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes, Flexi Menu integrates seamlessly with any WordPress theme.

Can I create multiple menus on the same page?

Absolutely! Flexi Menu supports multiple independent menus.

Does Flexi Menu impact my website’s loading speed?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized to maintain excellent site performance.
